name: FunASR Runtime
description: Alibaba DAMO Academy / ModelScope's industrial speech recognition toolkit whose runtime SDK (funasr-runtime) ships a self-hosted streaming/offline ASR server built on Paraformer, SenseVoice, and FSMN-VAD models. The canonical exposed surface is a WebSocket-Secure (wss) server on port 10095; a newer OpenAI-compatible HTTP server (funasr-server) exists on port 8000. No built-in authentication by default. The wss transport is Shodan http.html-blind and routes to Censys/active-probe fingerprinting.
auth_notes: No authentication in the funasr-runtime SDK servers. The primary runtime (funasr_wss_server.py / funasr-wss-server C++) binds port 10095 speaking a custom JSON-over-WebSocket-Secure protocol (client sends mode/chunk config, streams PCM, receives partial+final transcripts). It serves no HTML page, so Shodan http.html/http.title markers return 0 — fingerprint by port + wss handshake (Censys/active-probe). Self-signed TLS is auto-generated, so wss is on but certificate trust is meaningless. The newer OpenAI-compatible funasr-server (HTTP :8000, /v1/audio/transcriptions) is FastAPI-based and more http.html-visible where deployed. Neither server ships credential enforcement; guidance defers auth to the operator.

shodan_dorks.rationale: Port-based: funasr-runtime binds wss on 10095 with auto-generated self-signed TLS. FunASR serves no HTML on this port so http.html dorks return 0 — port + ssl/TLS presence is the reachable Shodan signal
Newer OpenAI-compatible funasr-server (HTTP :8000) renders the FunASR name into Swagger UI/JSON; catches the http.html-visible HTTP variant

The auto-generated self-signed cert on the 10095 wss runtime frequently carries a FunASR/localhost-style CN; cert-subject match on the runtime port is high precision. Best confirmed via Censys cert enumeration since Shodan does not capture the wss body

api_paths: WSS :10095 (JSON handshake: mode=offline|online|2pass, chunk_size, wav_name; streams PCM; returns partial/final text)
known_vulns: No built-in auth — any wss client completing the JSON handshake on 10095 gets unlimited ASR (offline/streaming/2-pass) at operator cost
Auto-generated self-signed TLS provides encryption but zero identity assurance — trivially MITM-able and no client authentication
GPU/CPU compute theft — no rate limiting on the runtime; continuous transcription jobs are automatable with the bundled funasr_wss_client
Audio PII exfiltration — Chinese/English/multilingual speech (call-center, medical, meeting audio typical of industrial FunASR use) transcribed with no consent or audit logging
Client-selectable mode/model in the handshake enables resource-selection DoS
funasr-server HTTP :8000 variant exposes FastAPI /docs and unauthenticated /v1/audio/transcriptions with unrestricted file upload
risk_notes: Primary attack vectors: (1) Compute theft — an open 10095 wss runtime or 8000 HTTP server is free industrial-grade ASR, scriptable with the shipped clients. (2) Audio PII exfiltration — FunASR is heavily deployed in Chinese enterprise/call-center/telephony contexts; open endpoints process sensitive customer and voice-print audio without auth. (3) MITM via meaningless self-signed TLS — the wss cert authenticates nothing, so an on-path attacker can intercept or impersonate. (4) Shodan-blindness on 10095 favors operator obscurity; Censys cert/handshake enumeration and active wss probing surface these hosts where http.html dorks miss them. (5) The HTTP variant adds the standard FastAPI unauth-upload and schema-disclosure surface.
deployment_notes: Docker-first via the funasr-runtime SDK images (registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/funasr_repo/funasr:funasr-runtime-sdk-*). Two server families: (a) the classic C++/Python wss runtime on 10095 (offline, online, and 2-pass SDK images) — serves NO HTML, Shodan http.html-blind, fingerprint via port+wss handshake or self-signed cert (Censys route); (b) the newer OpenAI-compatible funasr-server on HTTP :8000 with FastAPI /docs — http.html-visible. Auto-generated self-signed TLS on the wss port. A GGUF/llama.cpp single-binary edge runtime also exists (CPU/Vulkan/CUDA) but is not a network server. Common on Alibaba Cloud and Chinese GPU hosts; industrial/call-center deployments frequently expose 10095 directly. No auth by default on any variant.
